reviews.review_msg: I wouldn't take another course or program taught by this professor. Each class was heavy in lecture and if you had any difference of opinion then hers it was seen as disrespectful, But if you can just sit there and fit inside for her perfect student box you will be just fine.

A privilege to learn from Vicki. This course was truly transformative, deepening how I think about my role as an artist and educator. Her storytelling-based teaching makes classes engaging, reflective, and impactful.

I found Dr. Kelly's approach to be sincere and rigorous.  She is a knowledge-keeper and a brilliant storyteller.  Perhaps the best teacher I have ever known.  An artist in the truest sense, and a lecturer of the highest order.  Simply outstanding.

If you love flute solos, expressing theories through forming human tableaus and pastel drawing in a graduate level course on Educational Research Methods, then this is the course for you. If you are serious about scholarship and are looking for a prof who knows her stuff and is open to discussion of serious ideas, STAY AWAY!
